Enjoyed meeting with members of the Associated Builders and Contractors this week.

posts.text:
It was an honor to support my dear friend and Montgomery native Kasdin Mitchell’s nomination to be a U.S. District Judge this morning.

Kasdin’s intellect, integrity, grit, and commitment to service have made Alabama so proud. I have no doubt that when confirmed, she will serve with distinction on the federal bench.
